rationale: A burst water supply line in the policyholder's own home caused water damage to the basement structure and contents; this is direct damage to the policyholder's own property, not a third-party liability or theft.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's bathroom supply line burst while on a work trip, flooding the entire basement with approximately two inches of water over roughly 48 hours. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall (up to one foot high), and ruined stored contents. High-severity claim requiring immediate on-site inspection and mitigation assessment.

case_facts.description: approximately two inches of water across entire basement; hardwood floor buckled; drywall soaked up to one foot high; stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink; water ran for approximately two days

rationale: Wind-caused damage to the roof structure of the policyholder's own property with no third-party involvement or theft.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; four shingles blown off. Estimated repair cost $400 with no secondary damage or water intrusion. However, claim is below the $2,500 deductible and will not result in a payout.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off overhang above back porch
